about.title: About
about.description: I study computer science and cybersecurity at INSA Hauts-de-France. In my apprenticeship, I use GitHub Copilot for back-end development.
about.introduction: At SNCF Connect & Tech, I build and maintain Spring Boot APIs using agentic development. Outside work, I’m building an API that answers questions about documents with Spring AI and pgvector.

experience.title: Back-end developer intern
experience.detail: Built a notification microservice that integrates with Spring Boot services.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Six of my projects, including Java and Spring Boot APIs, a file encryption tool, and websites.

descriptions.rag: This Spring Boot REST API uses retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to answer questions about documents. It stores their embeddings in PostgreSQL with pgvector and generates answers with local Ollama models.
descriptions.picitApi: PicIt is a social network. Its REST API uses Java, Spring Boot, MongoDB, and Neo4j.
descriptions.picitFront: The PicIt social network’s web interface runs on Next.js. It uses TypeScript and Tailwind CSS.
descriptions.fcrypt: FCrypt encrypts text, image, audio, and video files from the command line. It’s written in Java with Spring Shell.
descriptions.clearLinks: These smart contracts handle donations, voting, and creator support on Sepolia, an Ethereum testnet.
descriptions.rythmopolis: Rythmopolis is a music events project. Its website uses Angular and Tailwind CSS.
